describe.gentle: Waits 5 minutes before the first reconnect and 15 between them; heavier steps after half an hour, an hour, two.
describe.steady: A reconnect after a minute, again every 5; heavier steps after 10, 20 and 60 minutes down.
describe.prompt: A reconnect at once, again every 3 minutes; heavier steps after 5, 15 and 30 minutes down.
describe.urgent: Everything soonest: heavier steps after 3, 8 and 30 minutes down.
describe.watch: Watch and log only. NetworkManager (or whatever runs the link) is left to itself.
describe.restart: Up to restarting the network service.
describe.radio: Up to resetting the radio (its USB device or driver).
describe.reboot: Up to rebooting the box: at most 3 times a day, never during a build or an update, nor soon after it started.
